about.title: Our Story
about.paragraph_1: Founded in 2026, our mission is to elevate your daily beverage ritual into an experience worth slowing down for. We blend the focused energy of coffee with the sophisticated relaxation of spirits.
about.paragraph_2: We source raw beans directly from carbon-neutral cooperative farms, ensuring transparent trade relations and exceptional bean selection. Our commitment extends beyond the cup to every detail on the menu.
about.paragraph_3: When dusk calls, our roastery seamlessly transitions into a lively cocktail bar. The roaring steam wands make way for shaker clinks as we pour craft elixirs until night close.
about.value_1_desc: Crafting a cozy local space designed for connection, laughter, and work.
about.value_2_desc: Partnering directly with regional organic dairies and pastry bakers.
about.value_3_desc: Obsessing over high-quality ingredients, from reverse-osmosis water to premium spirits.
